newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge Networks up on alliance rumors.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge Networks up on alliance rumors.

text.p: Shares in Newbridge Networks Corp leapt on Friday on speculation that it may be in alliance talks with U.S. remote access switch company Ascend Communications Inc.

"There's a rumor going around that talks are going on between Ascend and Newbridge," said one analyst, who declined to be identified. The analyst said such a pact seemed logical for Newbridge because the companies' technologies dovetailed nicely.
Ascend makes switching equipment to let those in remote offices access the Internet or their central office networks.
Newbridge shares shot up 2.65 to 43.80 on the Toronto Stock Exchange. On New York, Newbridge stock rose 2-1/8 to 32-1/2.
On Nasdaq, Ascend was up 1-1/8 at 64-3/8.
Analysts said Ascend could see Newbridge as an attractive partner due to its compatible technology and its existing pact with telecommunications equipment vendor Siemens AG.
"(Ascend doesn't) have, but has told us they really want, ATM (asynchronous transfer mode) and frame relay technology...Two, they want an alliance with a telecom equipment vendor," said the analyst.
Newbridge is a top-ranked producer of ATM equipment, which allows the high-speed transmission of voice, video and data across a network, and frame relay networking equipment.
Ascend could also have access to a possible tie-up with Siemens through Newbridge's link with the German telecommunications giant.
Canadian-based telecommunications equipment provider Northern Telecom Ltd this week signed a sales pact with Ascend competitor Shiva Corp.
Newbridge officials were not immediately available for comment on the market rumors.
